items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Jing Daily analyzes Gucci's early-September mainland China price cuts of roughly 30-40% on select bags and apparel (Ophidia mini bucket bag, GG Marmont bucket bag, Mercato tote). Frames Chinese consumer response as cautious wait-and-see, with buyers anticipating further reductions and increasingly favoring gold over branded leather goods -- a direct test of whether repricing alone can restore purchase confidence.

items.title: Gucci开启最高40%降价，中国市场倒逼奢侈品定价逻辑？
items.summary: Chinese financial media outlet reports Gucci's rare official China price cut (up to 40% on items like the Ophidia mini bucket bag and GG Marmont bucket bag) as a break from the industry's long-standing only-raise-never-lower pricing norm. Cites Kering CEO Luca de Meo acknowledging the industry's post-pandemic 'pricing power' has eroded and some items were priced beyond what demand could bear.

items.title: 디자이너, CEO도 바꿔도 비틀대는 구찌, 1분기 매출 -8%
items.summary: Hankyung reports Gucci Q1 2026 revenue fell 8% year-on-year to EUR 1.347 billion despite the creative-director and CEO changes, with Europe and Asia underperforming while North America grew. Kering group-wide Asia sales fell 6% in Q1, Japan down 14% -- the steepest regional decline -- attributed to a weak Chinese property market, youth unemployment, and ultra-wealthy buyers rotating spend toward jewelry over fashion.

items.title: 명품 大위기…구찌, 中수요부진에 2분기 매출 19% '뚝'
items.summary: Edaily covers Gucci's Q2 2026 revenue drop of 19% amid continued weak Chinese demand, part of a broader Kering earnings disappointment described as a 'luxury crisis.' Included for context on the sustained China demand slump underlying the September price cuts, though the article itself is dated mid-year.

items.title: 구찌, 서로 다른 시선을 하나의 순간에 담다 (2026 가을-겨울 아이웨어 캠페인)
items.summary: Korean textile-trade outlet covers Gucci's newly unveiled 2026 fall-winter eyewear campaign, portraying figures in contemplative solo moments wearing Double-G acetate frames and Horsebit-detailed round sunglasses. Standard brand activation/PR coverage, freshest item found for Korea in the review window.

items.title: "장인 정신과 창의성 기다린다더니"…구찌, AI 화보 논란 [명품價 이야기]
items.summary: Critical-angle piece: Gucci's Milan Fashion Week AI-generated campaign imagery (elderly model in furs walking through a restaurant, satellite/horse surrealist elements) drew Korean netizen backlash for contradicting the brand's craftsmanship positioning. Quoted reactions: 'Gucci failed to find a real Milanese grandmother to wear 1976 fashion -- these are dark times' and 'inappropriate for a luxury brand that touts expertise to use AI for advertising.' An academic quoted questions whether cutting-edge tech helps or hurts brand image. Dated but the AI-authenticity critique remains a live thread in ongoing NEA commentary about the brand under Demna.

items.title: "84곳 문 닫았다"…매장 줄이는 명품 브랜드의 속내
items.summary: Kering closed 84 stores group-wide in H1 2026 (~5% of directly-operated fleet), targeting up to 100 closures for the year across Gucci, Saint Laurent and Bottega Veneta, including 25 regular Gucci department-store locations and 11 outlet stores. Framed as a 'quality over quantity' pivot toward flagship experience spaces in cities like Seoul and Tokyo; Gucci's sales decline reportedly narrowed from -8% to -2% quarter over quarter despite the cuts.

items.title: 古驰突然大降价：最高降40%！经典款跌破万元，还能买吗？
items.summary: Chinese product-review/finance-influencer Weibo post breaking down Gucci's China discounts by product line, framing the cuts as Kering's performance-driven 'trade price for volume' move. Discussion thread includes buyer-segment guidance (self-use vs. resale-value buyers) and reiterates that most discounted styles now lose value immediately on resale. No visible like/comment/share counts on the page.

items.title: 最高降幅超40%！古驰Gucci多款包包成衣罕见降价
items.summary: Chinese deal/consumer-community post (SMZDM, a shopping-deals forum) itemizes the Gucci China discounts and invites reader comment on whether now is a good time to buy, reflecting bargain-hunting community sentiment rather than brand-loyalty enthusiasm. No visible engagement metrics captured on fetch.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 관련 소비자 게시글 (가격/품질 논의)
items.summary: Korean community board (DCInside luxury gallery) hosting ongoing threads where users compare Gucci pricing swings against Dior/Fendi/Ferragamo and discuss whether repeated unpredictable price changes ('아무 원칙 없이') are eroding trust. Board-level aggregate observed, not a single thread; representative of community-channel chatter volume rather than one measurable post.

items.title: 구찌-페라가모-펜디 '명품백' 소비자 '등' 돌렸다
items.summary: Korean consumer-affairs outlet covers Gucci Korea's sales decline (-5.2% to KRW 244.3bn, operating profit -8.6%) alongside steeper drops at Ferragamo and Fendi Korea, attributing the pullback to parallel imports/overseas direct purchases eroding price premiums and a consumer shift away from visible logos. Industry source quoted: the era of buying luxury 'solely for the name' has ended.

items.title: Gucci's China shock reverberates across the luxury landscape
items.summary: Bloomberg-sourced wire analysis situates Gucci's China price cuts within a sector-wide reassessment of luxury pricing power, noting Kering's H1 2026 Asia-Pacific comparable sales fell roughly 10% and framing Gucci as the bellwether case for whether discounting can rebuild volume without further damaging brand equity. Included here for the China market angle though the syndicating outlet is Thai; original wire content concerns the NEA market most directly.
